note: Instrument ids are exactly as published by the NASA OSDR RadLab API. The descriptions are AstroLife's short summaries of public mission information; they were not returned by the API, and RadLab's own documentation was unavailable when this file was written. Instruments without a description are shown by id only.

DosTel1.label: DOSTEL 1 · International Space Station
DosTel1.description: Dosimetry telescope of the DOSIS 3D experiment in the ISS Columbus laboratory, in low Earth orbit.

Lidal.label: LIDAL · International Space Station
Lidal.description: Light Ion Detector for ALTEA, operated on the International Space Station in low Earth orbit.

CRaTER-D1D2.label: CRaTER · Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
CRaTER-D1D2.description: Cosmic Ray Telescope for the Effects of Radiation on NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, in lunar orbit.

MSL-RAD-Surface.label: RAD · Curiosity rover
MSL-RAD-Surface.description: Radiation Assessment Detector on NASA's Mars Science Laboratory Curiosity rover, on the surface of Mars.

Liulin-MO-AB-Orbit.label: Liulin-MO (AB) · Trace Gas Orbiter
Liulin-MO-AB-Orbit.description: Liulin-MO dosimeter on the ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter, in orbit around Mars.

Liulin-MO-CD-Orbit.label: Liulin-MO (CD) · Trace Gas Orbiter
Liulin-MO-CD-Orbit.description: Liulin-MO dosimeter on the ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter, in orbit around Mars.
